1.w: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

2.w: “Son of man, how is the wood of the vine more than any wood, the [vine] branch that is among the trees of the forest?

3.w: Is wood taken from it it to use for work? Or do they make from it a peg to hang any vessel on it?

4.w: Behold, it is given to the fire for food; the two of its ends the fire devours, and the middle of it is burned. Is it useful for work?

5.w: Behold, in its being complete, it could not be made for work; how much [less] when the fire has devoured it and it is burned, can it even be made yet for work!

6.w: Therefore, thus says the Lord YHWH: ‘Just like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for food, so I have given those dwelling in Jerusalem.

7.w: And I will set My face against them; from the fire they will come out, and the fire will devour them! And you⁺ will know that I [am] YHWH, in My setting My face against them.

8.w: And I will make the land a desolation, because they have acted unfaithfully—an unfaithfulness’—a declaration of the Lord YHWH.”
